title: Breezy Ligne-Claire
description: Un style d'illustration de bande dessinée minimaliste défini par des aplats de couleurs vives et des contours noirs uniformes et légèrement tremblants. Il ne comporte ni ombres ni dégradés, s'appuyant sur des formes 2D épurées et des tracés nets pour créer une esthétique ludique et artisanale.
description_en: A minimalist comic illustration style defined by solid, vibrant color blocks and uniform, slightly wobbly black outlines. It features zero shading or gradients, relying entirely on clean 2D shapes and stark linework to create a playful, handcrafted aesthetic.
description_fr: Un style d'illustration de bande dessinée minimaliste défini par des aplats de couleurs vives et des contours noirs uniformes et légèrement tremblants. Il ne comporte ni ombres ni dégradés, s'appuyant sur des formes 2D épurées et des tracés nets pour créer une esthétique ludique et artisanale.
prompt: Digital flat illustration, naïve minimalist comic art style drawing heavily from clear-line (ligne claire) traditions and quirky pop illustration. Apply this style to the complete scene described by {{subject}}, preserving its factual content, camera angle, framing, spatial layout, and stated exclusions. Render the scene using solid, unshaded blocks of {{primary_color}}, {{accent_color}}, and {{secondary_color}}. All forms must be defined by uniform, slightly wobbly black outlines that mimic a hand-drawn marker or ink pen, yet remain entirely flat in their fill. Lighting is strictly non-existent; use purely flat colors with zero gradients, zero drop shadows, zero highlights, and zero volumetric rendering. The color palette must be vibrant, high-key, and distinctly separated by the stark black contouring. Internal details should be minimized to simple graphic marks, such as isolated squiggles or dots for texture. Edges are crisp but organic, showing deliberate slight jitter or irregularity rather than perfect geometric vector curves, giving a relaxed, handcrafted feel. Texture is completely matte and clean, lacking any canvas weave, film grain, or halftone dots, resulting in a pristine, screen-printed or retro cel-animation appearance. Depth is intentionally flattened into a 2D plane, relying entirely on overlapping shapes and stark color banding rather than atmospheric perspective. The composition must fill the entire canvas without interruption. video.motion: Subjects and environment elements should animate with a slight, continuous line boil (jitter) typical of retro cel animation, while maintaining perfectly flat color fills. Motion must be snappy, 2D-plane restricted, and avoid any 3D rotation.
video.camera: The camera must remain locked in a static, flat 2D perspective, utilizing only simple horizontal pans or hard cuts without any parallax or z-axis movement.
video.temporal_texture: The uniform black outlines must exhibit a continuous, subtle hand-drawn boil, while the flat color fills remain perfectly stable and clean without any grain or lighting shifts over time.
video.avoid: Avoid motion blur, 3D rotation, dynamic lighting changes, gradient transitions, and any smooth vector interpolation that ruins the hand-drawn jitter.
